title: CKY TV film of object jumping from the ground to 5,000 ft

tellings.quote: So in May the CKY film was caught on film. They caught this thing jumping from the ground to 5,000 ft in the air in three frames, four frames.
May 13th, 1975. Cameraman Alan Carr of station CKY in Manitoba photographs two separate sightings over Carman in front of four witnesses.
tellings.difference: Gives the date as 13 May 1975, names the cameraman as Alan Carr and says four witnesses saw two separate sightings.
tellings.link_reason: Same CKY filming of the Carman object in May 1975 as telling 7, here narrated in the documentary.

as_told.title: CKY film editor's account of filming the object

plain: In May 1975, a crew from CKY, a television station in Manitoba, Canada, is said to have filmed an object near the town of Carman leaping from the ground to 5,000 feet in the space of three or four film frames. The researcher Grant Cameron tells it, crediting a CKY documentary about the film. A passage from the French researcher Jacques Vallée, from a work titled UFOs: It Has Begun, gives more detail: on May 13th, 1975, a cameraman named Alan Carr filmed two separate sightings over Carman in front of four witnesses. Cameron adds something he says he learned by talking to the man who shot it: he was not a cameraman at all but a film editor at the studio. So the tellers agree on the film but differ on who held the camera. It is told because an object rising that fast would be beyond any known aircraft.
